preconditions.description: The number of time-steps n must be between 1 and 200.
The number of bananas m must be between 2 and 100000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= t_i <= 2 for t_i in operations)
preconditions.description: Each operation type t_i must be either 1 or 2.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= y_i <= m for y_i in operations)
preconditions.description: Each y_i must be between 1 and m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x_prime_i <= 100000 * m for x_prime_i in operations)
preconditions.description: Each x'_i must be between 1 and 100000 * m.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly m integers.
Each output integer must be either -1 or a positive integer representing the earliest time-step.

postconditions.expression: all(int(x) <= n for x in stdout.split() if int(x) != -1)
postconditions.description: Each valid output integer must not exceed the number of time-steps n.
